title: Raspberry Pi board in a clear case
visual_facts: A small green circuit board is enclosed in a transparent plastic case.
The board has a central square chip and several smaller components.
A yellow pair of connectors is near the upper center and a blue connector is to its right.
A metal connector marked HDMI is visible near the upper right edge.
Two black USB ports protrude from the right side and a black cable connector is on the left.
The board is photographed on a gray textured surface.
spatial_relations: The board lies flat inside the clear case, with its connector ports along the upper and side edges.
uncertainties: The small component labels are not fully readable.
No exact board revision beyond the visible markings can be established.
